data.long_meaning: The name Imalda has an uncertain origin, but its meaning is often described as ‘diligent’ or ‘hardworking’. It may be derived from the Latin word ‘imalus’, meaning ‘servant’ or ‘slave’. In Christian tradition, the name Imalda is associated with dedication and devotion to God. The name Imalda carries the meaning “Diligent and hardworking” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Greek, Latin. Parents who choose Imalda usually hope their child will grow to embody diligent and hardworking and live with faith, good character and purpose.
